Backend, devices and processes

Source: R/api_misc.R
default_backend.Rd

Ports of jax.default_backend, jax.device_count, jax.local_device_count, jax.local_devices, jax.process_index, jax.process_count and jax.process_indices (and the deprecated aliases jax.host_id, jax.host_count, jax.host_ids, which warn as in JAX). jaxR runs one process on the devices of one PJRT client.

Usage

default_backend()

device_count(backend = NULL)

local_device_count(backend = NULL)

local_devices(process_index = NULL, backend = NULL, host_id = NULL)

process_index(backend = NULL)

process_count(backend = NULL)

process_indices(backend = NULL)

host_id(backend = NULL)

host_count(backend = NULL)

host_ids(backend = NULL)

Arguments

backend

Ignored (one backend).

process_index

Process index (only 0 exists).

host_id

Deprecated alias of process_index.

Value

The platform name, a count, an index, or device descriptions (as devices()).
